description: This file defines the 'Post' class within the 'Goteo\Model\Call' namespace. The class manages posts associated with calls, providing methods for retrieving posts, validating, saving, and removing associations between posts and calls in a blog or content management context.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class representing posts linked to calls; includes methods for fetching, validating, saving, and removing posts from calls.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of posts associated with a specific call, optionally with language considerations, including images and header images.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the Post object ensuring required fields (id and call) are present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates the association between a post and a call in the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the association between a post and a call from the database.
